conceptsInvented.name: Voice-exhaust training
conceptsInvented.description: Repurposing throwaway SuperWhisper recordings — the ones that didn't go anywhere — as training corpus for a voice-clone model. The 'exhaust' of daily thinking-out-loud becomes data.

conceptsInvented.name: PS5 controller programming
conceptsInvented.description: Outfitting a DualSense to act as a keyboard-free programming surface. Hands free for thinking + voice; buttons for mode switches.

conceptsInvented.name: Peer-approval mesh
conceptsInvented.description: Every agent's exec-approval list is generated from a canonical peer registry. Agents sign approvals for each other with ed25519. Murch is out of the loop for routine gates.

conceptsInvented.name: Caddy-as-shaper
conceptsInvented.description: An orchestrator agent that doesn't just route — she templates configs, runs token FinOps, and rewrites her teammates' boot files. (CADDY-AS-SHAPER.md)

conceptsInvented.name: Agent ecology with named identities
conceptsInvented.description: The squad has names, machines, roles, failure modes. Not 'instance-7' — Caddy, ClawLee, Rosie. The identity carries operational meaning.

conceptsInvented.name: RAMS from postmortems
conceptsInvented.description: Agent failure write-ups feed back into a training pipeline that updates skills. Mistakes are corpus, not waste.

conceptsInvented.name: Heartbeat sub-agents on free-tier
conceptsInvented.description: Routine state-check ticks run on free-tier models in fresh contexts; only escalate to the priced primary when there's drift. Routine cost: $0.

conceptsInvented.name: Token FinOps as agent discipline
conceptsInvented.description: Every tool has a row in a token dashboard; subscription tiers track against actual usage; agents prefer free pools first.
